occurrences.text: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.
Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
